verdict.rationale: Community evidence identifies the actual charter holders (First Internet Bank, Blue Ridge Bank) and characterizes Increase as an API layer atop real banks rather than a bank itself, and docs mention pass-through FDIC insurance via IntraFi network banks. However, there is no first-party documentation naming the sponsor bank(s) directly, no explicit disclosure of Increase's role (direct program vs middleware) in its own docs, and no evidence describing what happens to customer funds/accounts if Increase or its partner bank fails. missing for 10: first-party bank/charter disclosure, explicit failure/wind-down procedures, clarity on Increase's own regulatory role vs partner bank's.
